additional_experiments.description: List of experiments that should be used by the job. An example value is ["enable_stackdriver_agent_metrics"].
additional_experiments.rationale: List of experiments that should be used by the job.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

enable_streaming_engine.description: Indicates if the job should use the streaming engine feature.
enable_streaming_engine.rationale: Toggles Dataflow Streaming Engine, which offloads state to the managed backend. This is a performance/cost/architecture choice; it does not constitute an access, exposure, or encryption control, so it is not a security archetype.

ip_configuration.description: The configuration for VM IPs. Options are "WORKER_IP_PUBLIC" or "WORKER_IP_PRIVATE".
ip_configuration.rationale: Assigning public IPs to Dataflow workers increases the attack surface by exposing VMs to the internet. Using private IPs ensures workers communicate only within the VPC, reducing the risk of unauthorized access.

kms_key_name.description: The name for the Cloud KMS key for the job. Key format is: projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/keyRings/KEY_RING/cryptoKeys/KEY
kms_key_name.rationale: Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) ensure that data processed by Dataflow is encrypted with keys controlled by the organization, meeting compliance requirements and providing an additional layer of data protection.

labels.description:
User labels to be specified for the job. Keys and values should follow the restrictions specified in the labeling restrictions page. NOTE: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
				Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: User labels to be specified for the job. Keys and values should follow the restrictions specified in the labeling restrictions page. Note: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field effective_labels for all of the labels present on the resource.

machine_type.description: The machine type to use for the job.
machine_type.rationale: The machine type to use for the job.

max_workers.description: The number of workers permitted to work on the job. More workers may improve processing speed at additional cost.
max_workers.rationale: The number of workers permitted to work on the job. More workers may improve processing speed at additional cost.

name.description: A unique name for the resource, required by Dataflow.
name.rationale: A unique name for the resource, required by Dataflow.

network.description: The network to which VMs will be assigned. If it is not provided, "default" will be used.
network.rationale: Identifier referencing the VPC network Dataflow workers attach to. Which network a team uses is a reference to another resource, not a control on this job; segmentation is enforced on the network/firewall, not by this pointer.

on_delete.description: One of "drain" or "cancel". Specifies behavior of deletion during terraform destroy.
on_delete.rationale: Selects whether a job is drained or cancelled on deletion. This is an operational/data-handling lifecycle choice for the team and does not control access, exposure, or encryption.

parameters.description: Key/Value pairs to be passed to the Dataflow job (as used in the template).
parameters.rationale: Key/value pairs to be passed to the Dataflow job (as used in the template). Keys are case-sensitive based on the language on which the pipeline is coded, mostly Java. Note: do not configure Dataflow options here in parameters.

project.description: The project in which the resource belongs.
project.rationale: The project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

region.description: The region in which the created job should run.
region.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

service_account_email.description: The Service Account email used to create the job.
service_account_email.rationale: References the service account Dataflow workers run as. A policy should require an explicit, non-default service account (the default Compute Engine SA is over-privileged) to enforce least privilege; it must not pin a specific account.

skip_wait_on_job_termination.description: If true, treat DRAINING and CANCELLING as terminal job states and do not wait for further changes before removing from terraform state and moving on. WARNING: this will lead to job name conflicts if you do not ensure that the job names are different, e.g. by embedding a release ID or by using a random_id.
skip_wait_on_job_termination.rationale: If true, treat DRAINING and CANCELLING as terminal states and do not wait for further changes before removing from terraform state and moving on.

subnetwork.description: The subnetwork to which VMs will be assigned. Should be of the form "regions/REGION/subnetworks/SUBNETWORK".
subnetwork.rationale: Identifier referencing the subnetwork Dataflow workers attach to. It is a reference to another resource (the team's chosen subnet); we don't constrain references to other resources.

temp_gcs_location.description: A writeable location on Google Cloud Storage for the Dataflow job to dump its temporary data.
temp_gcs_location.rationale: A writeable location on GCS for the Dataflow job to dump its temporary data.

template_gcs_path.description: The Google Cloud Storage path to the Dataflow job template.
template_gcs_path.rationale: The GCS path to the Dataflow job template.

transform_name_mapping.description: Only applicable when updating a pipeline. Map of transform name prefixes of the job to be replaced with the corresponding name prefixes of the new job.
transform_name_mapping.rationale: Only applicable when updating a pipeline. Map of transform name prefixes of the job to be replaced with the corresponding name prefixes of the new job.

zone.description: The zone in which the created job should run. If it is not provided, the provider zone is used.
zone.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).
